 106: class _WorkerRuntimeOwnerProposal(_WorkerModelRegistryProposal):
 107:     """The inherited registry itself remains the capability's runtime identity.
 108: 
 109:     One private bootstrap permit controls serial operation entry. State locks do
 110:     not span work; the active operation/thread identity prevents overlap. Real
 111:     callers still need the unimplemented trusted bootstrap/loader/PCM ports.
 112:     """
 113: 
 114:     def __init__(self, bootstrap_permit, expected_factory_type):
 115:         _require(expected_factory_type is _OwnedFactoryPortProposal, 'fixed_factory_type_required')
 116:         super().__init__(bootstrap_permit, expected_factory_type)
 117:         self._operation = None
 118:         self._namespace = None
 119:         self._namespace_lease = None
 120:         self._product = None
 121:         self._pcm_owner = None
 122:         self._pcm_issued = False
 123:         self._retained = None
 124:         self._engine_attempt = None
 125: 
 126:     def _permit_locked(self, permit):
 127:         _require(permit is self._bootstrap_permit, 'bootstrap_permit_identity')
 128: 
 129:     def _entry_locked(self, phases):
 130:         self._live_locked()
 131:         entry = self._operation
 132:         _require(entry is not None and entry[1] == get_ident() and entry[2] in phases,
 133:                  'serial_operation_required')
 134:         return entry[0]
 135: 
 136:     @contextmanager
 137:     def operation(self, permit, phase):
 138:         with self._lock:
 139:             self._permit_locked(permit)
 140:             self._live_locked()
 141:             _require(type(phase) is str and phase in _PHASES, 'operation_phase')
 142:             _require(self._operation is None, 'operation_already_active')
 143:             token = object()
 144:             self._operation = (token, get_ident(), phase)
 145:         try:
 146:             yield token
 147:         except BaseException as original:
 148:             try:
 149:                 self.revoke_generation(permit)
 150:             except BaseException as cleanup:
 151:                 BaseException.add_note(original, 'Runtime owner revocation unconfirmed: ' + type(cleanup).__name__)
 152:             raise
 153:         finally:
 154:             with self._lock:
 155:                 # No references to native products are dropped by leaving work.
 156:                 if self._operation is not None and self._operation[0] is token:
 157:                     self._operation = None

 159:     def issue_generated_namespace(self, permit, pieces):
 160:         with self._lock:
 161:             self._permit_locked(permit)
 162:             self._entry_locked(('issue',))
 163:             _require(self._namespace is None and type(pieces) is tuple and len(pieces) == len(_NAMES),
 164:                      'generated_namespace_single_issue')
 165:             _require(all(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= 128 for raw in pieces),
 166:                      'generated_member_bound')
 167:             members = tuple((name, raw) for name, raw in zip(_NAMES, pieces, strict=True))
 168:             # A deliberately non-path label. It cannot pass the real owned
 169:             # loader's absolute-path check or authenticate a real namespace.
 170:             digest = hashlib.sha256(b''.join(len(raw).to_bytes(2, 'big') + raw for raw in pieces)).hexdigest()
 171:             self._namespace = _GeneratedNamespace('generated:' + digest, members)
 172:             return self._namespace

 174:     def assert_generated_namespace_binding(self, namespace):
 175:         with self._lock:
 176:             self._entry_locked(('factory', 'use'))
 177:             _require(namespace is self._namespace and type(namespace) is _GeneratedNamespace,
 178:                      'namespace_identity')

 180:     def issue_admitted_namespace_lease(self, permit, pinned_namespace, read_set, model, profile, manifest_sha256):
 181:         with self._lock:
 182:             self._permit_locked(permit)
 183:             self._entry_locked(('issue',))
 184:             _require(self._namespace_lease is None, 'admitted_namespace_lease_already_issued')
 185:             _require(pinned_namespace is not None and getattr(pinned_namespace, '_ready', False) is True,
 186:                      'materialized_pinned_namespace_required')
 187:             _require(read_set is not None and not read_set.unconfirmed and not read_set.released,
 188:                      'live_read_set_required')
 189:             _require(pinned_namespace._read_set is read_set, 'read_set_namespace_binding')
 190:             _require(type(manifest_sha256) is str and len(manifest_sha256) == 64
 191:                      and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in manifest_sha256), 'manifest_sha256_hex')
 192:             _require(model is not None and hasattr(model, 'assets'), 'admitted_model_required')
 193:             _require(profile is not None and getattr(profile, 'device', None) == 'cpu', 'qualified_cpu_profile_required')
 194:             buffers = pinned_namespace.buffers
 195:             _require(type(buffers) is MappingProxyType and len(buffers) in (4, 5), 'immutable_buffers_required')
 196:             label = 'uoink-memory-' + pinned_namespace.namespace_sha256
 197:             lease = _AdmittedNamespaceLease(
 198:                 owner=self,
 199:                 generation=self._generation,
 200:                 read_set=read_set,
 201:                 pinned_namespace=pinned_namespace,
 202:                 buffers=buffers,
 203:                 model=model,
 204:                 profile=profile,
 205:                 manifest_sha256=manifest_sha256,
 206:                 namespace_sha256=pinned_namespace.namespace_sha256,
 207:                 label=label,
 208:                 active=True,
 209:             )
 210:             self._namespace_lease = lease
 211:             return lease

 214:         with self._lock:

 216:             _require(self._namespace_lease is not None and self._namespace_lease is lease
 217:                      and type(lease) is _AdmittedNamespaceLease,
 218:                      'admitted_namespace_lease_identity')
 219:             _require(lease.active is True and lease.generation is self._generation and lease.owner is self,
 220:                      'admitted_namespace_lease_active_and_generation')
 221:             _require(not lease.read_set.unconfirmed and not lease.read_set.released,
 222:                      'admitted_read_set_unconfirmed_or_released')
 223:             _require(lease.pinned_namespace._ready, 'admitted_namespace_not_ready')

 225:     def register_vad_product_for_bootstrap(self, permit, factory, product, owned_module):
 226:         with self._lock:
 227:             self._permit_locked(permit)
 228:             self._entry_locked(('factory',))
 229:             _require((self._namespace is not None or self._namespace_lease is not None) and self._product is None,
 230:                      'namespace_or_product_order')
 231:             _require(type(factory) is self._factory_type and type(owned_module) is ModuleType
 232:                      and factory._owned_runtime_module is owned_module and owned_module._RUNTIME is self,
 233:                      'factory_runtime_identity')
 234:             capability = self._capability
 235:             _require(type(capability) is _FactoryModelCapability and factory._model_capability is capability,
 236:                      'registered_factory_capability')
 237:             completed = factory._completed
 238:             _require(factory._attempted is True and factory._quarantined_owner is None
 239:                      and type(completed) is _FactoryOwner and completed.vad is product
 240:                      and product is not None and type(product) is factory._factory.VoiceActivitySegmentation
 241:                      and completed.model_lease is self._lease, 'completed_factory_product')
 242:             capability.assert_factory_and_runtime(factory, owned_module)
 243:             completed.model_lease.assert_bound(factory, completed.model)
 244:             self._product = _VADOwner(factory, owned_module, completed.model, product,
 245:                                       completed.model_lease, self._generation)

 247:     def _vad_locked(self, vad):
 248:         record = self._product
 249:         _require(record is not None and record.active is True and record.generation is self._generation
 250:                  and record.vad is vad, 'vad_product_identity')
 251:         completed = record.factory._completed
 252:         if not (record.factory._owned_runtime_module is record.owned_module
 253:                 and record.owned_module._RUNTIME is self and type(completed) is _FactoryOwner
 254:                 and completed.vad is vad and completed.model is record.model
 255:                 and completed.model_lease is record.lease):
 256:             self.revoke_generation(self._bootstrap_permit)
 257:             raise RuntimeOwnerRefusal('factory_product_or_runtime_changed')
 258:         record.lease.assert_bound(record.factory, record.model)
 259:         return record

 274:     def _begin_generated_engine(self, permit, namespace, vad):
 275:         with self._lock:
 276:             self._permit_locked(permit)
 277:             operation = self._entry_locked(('engine',))
 278:             _require(self._engine_attempt is None, 'engine_single_attempt')
 279:             _require(type(namespace) is _GeneratedNamespace and namespace is self._namespace,
 280:                      'issued_generated_namespace_required')
 281:             product = self._vad_locked(vad)
 282:             attempt = _EngineConstructionAttempt(
 283:                 self, self._generation, operation, namespace, product)
 284:             # Retain before any constructor or later preparation step. A private
 285:             # record created elsewhere cannot pass the identity check below.
 286:             self._engine_attempt = attempt
 287:             return attempt

 289:     def _begin_admitted_engine(self, permit, namespace_lease, vad):
 290:         with self._lock:
 291:             self._permit_locked(permit)
 292:             operation = self._entry_locked(('engine',))
 293:             _require(self._engine_attempt is None, 'engine_single_attempt')
 294:             _require(type(namespace_lease) is _AdmittedNamespaceLease and namespace_lease is self._namespace_lease,
 295:                      'admitted_namespace_lease_identity')
 296:             _require(namespace_lease.active is True and namespace_lease.generation is self._generation
 297:                      and namespace_lease.owner is self, 'admitted_namespace_lease_active')
 298:             product = self._vad_locked(vad)
 299:             _require(product is self._product, 'product_vad_mismatch')
 300:             attempt = _EngineConstructionAttempt(
 301:                 self, self._generation, operation, namespace_lease, product)
 302:             self._engine_attempt = attempt

 305:     def _engine_identity_locked(self, attempt):
 306:         _require(type(attempt) is _EngineConstructionAttempt
 307:                  and self._engine_attempt is attempt and attempt.owner is self
 308:                  and attempt.generation is self._generation,
 309:                  'engine_attempt_identity')
 310: 
 311:     def _engine_live_locked(self, attempt):
 312:         self._engine_identity_locked(attempt)
 313:         _require(self._entry_locked(('engine',)) is attempt.operation
 314:                  and attempt.active is True, 'engine_operation_identity')
 315:         _require(((type(attempt.namespace) is _GeneratedNamespace and attempt.namespace is self._namespace)
 316:                   or (type(attempt.namespace) is _AdmittedNamespaceLease and attempt.namespace is self._namespace_lease
 317:                       and attempt.namespace.active is True))
 318:                  and attempt.product is self._product, 'engine_issuance_changed')
 319:         self._vad_locked(attempt.product.vad)

 321:     def _retain_generated_engine_model(self, attempt, model):
 322:         with self._lock:
 323:             self._engine_identity_locked(attempt)
 324:             _require(not attempt.model_returned, 'engine_model_already_returned')
 325:             # Custody precedes liveness/type checks. Revoke may have won while
 326:             # the constructor ran; its returned value must still be retained.
 327:             attempt.model = model
 328:             attempt.model_returned = True
 329:             self._engine_live_locked(attempt)
 330:             _require(type(model) is _GeneratedEngineModel, 'generated_engine_model_type')

 333:         with self._lock:

 335:             _require(attempt.model_returned
 336:                      and type(attempt.model) is _GeneratedEngineModel
 337:                      and attempt.model.prepared is True
 338:                      and attempt.model.namespace is attempt.namespace
 339:                      and attempt.model.vad is attempt.product.vad,
 340:                      'engine_model_preparation_order')

 343:         with self._lock:

 345:             _require(not attempt.pipeline_returned, 'engine_pipeline_already_returned')

 348:             self._engine_live_locked(attempt)

 358:                      and not attempt.published

 360:                      and type(pipeline) is _GeneratedEnginePipeline,
 361:                      'engine_complete_before_publication')
 362:             _require(model.prepared is True and pipeline.prepared is True
 363:                      and model.namespace is attempt.namespace
 364:                      and model.vad is attempt.product.vad
 365:                      and pipeline.model is model and pipeline.vad is attempt.product.vad,
 366:                      'generated_engine_final_identity')
 367:             # This attribute is the retained generated fixture's actual link.
 368:             # No inference about a real WhisperX object's shape is admitted.

 370:                      is attempt.product.model, 'generated_vad_model_link')
